item: Tesseract finally termination — OCR backfill run
job: admin-api action trigger-pdf-backfill (the repo's own PDF OCR backfill; heartbeat -> trigger_pdf_backfill -> windows-agent runPdfBackfill/processOne)

gate.acknowledge_text_verbatim: Live-proof probes for u2giants/popdam3 issue #469 heavy items, delegated by parent agent: trigger and observe the repo's own PDF OCR backfill job (admin-api trigger-pdf-backfill; 619 unsampled licensing/tech-pack PDFs remaining) and prove Tesseract worker termination with logs and code-path evidence; exercise the frontend batch-loop cap at the smallest safe scope using intercepted RPC responses with no production bulk operation; prove ensureRootMarkers hourly backoff at unit/simulation level plus deployed code path without changing SMB/share permissions. No destructive actions, no schema changes, no credential changes. Tonight's NAS fixtures in _ai_test_681/ are owned by scheduled one-shot checks and are not touched.

pdf_backfill_config.note: Snapshot kept: triggering a fresh run replaces this config record (the repo's UI Start button does the same). count_pdf_rescan_remaining stays data-derived (693), so future rescan work is not lost. The prior run's stats were: failed 1043, replaced 18543, designers_filled 7082, files_used_added 3283, technical_designers_filled 3044.

outcome_rows_query.sql: SELECT extraction_method, ocr_engine, left(coalesce(extraction_error,''),120) AS err, filename FROM pdf_text_samples WHERE sampled_at >= '2026-11-15T23:52:00Z' AND extraction_method <> 'pdf_text' LIMIT 25
outcome_rows_query.finding: All 9 failed rows are pre-OCR file-missing errors (ENOENT stat on Z:\Decor\... paths whose source files no longer exist). Both skipped rows have empty error. ocr_engine is null on every row: the OCR branch was never entered in this run.

run.worker_observation: Zero Tesseract/Indra OCR workers were created (608/619 took the embedded-text fast path pdf_text; 9 failed before OCR at file stat). The run reached its normal terminal state with live_current_step=idle, no worker processes to survive it, and windows-render-agent heartbeats stayed healthy throughout (26 s at final poll).

code_path_evidence.fix_commit: 2287f1b5 (PR #713) changed all four OCR sites from `const result = await worker.recognize(pngBuffer); await worker.terminate();` (terminate skipped when recognize rejects — leaked worker) to `await worker.recognize(pngBuffer).finally(() => worker.terminate())` (terminate runs on both settle paths).

failure_path_simulation.what_it_runs: The four fix statements extracted VERBATIM from the source sites, against a mock worker whose recognize() rejects.
failure_path_simulation.observations: Per site: recognize resolves -> terminate called once; recognize rejects -> terminate called once (the audit case); pre-#713 statement order control -> terminate zero times on rejection (documents the leak that was fixed).

scope_notes: The live run exercised the repo's OCR backfill job end to end, but every successful file had >=100 chars of embedded PDF text, so the OCR branch (Indra first, tesseract.js fallback) was not entered; termination of Tesseract workers is proven by code path + failure simulation, not by a live tesseract process in this run.
ocr_indra.state=ready on windows-render-agent, so even a scanned-PDF run would use Indra there; tesseract.js engages only where Indra is absent or fails per file.

Forcing OCR onto the bridge agent (PDF_TEXT_SAMPLE_REQUEST.force_bridge) was deliberately not done: the repo routes OCR away from the Synology bridge because Tesseract there spikes NAS CPU (agent-api comment on compat-audit), and tonight's NAS fixture checks depend on that host.
The indra_rescan quiet-hour rule (12:30-3:00 AM ET) gated the 693-file rescan remainder; the fresh normal-mode trigger had 619 real unsampled PDFs and is not quiet-hour gated.
disclosed_writes: PDF_BACKFILL admin_config row replaced by the standard trigger (pre-image captured above; run record: 619 processed, status completed).
608 pdf_text_samples rows (extraction_method=pdf_text) + 9 failed rows + 2 skipped rows from the run — the job's normal output.
